about_the_game:
Animal Smash is a charming, casual pull-and-throw game where you launch cute animals through colorful farm-inspired levels. Play at your own pace, master your aim, and enjoy a relaxing experience perfect for players of all ages.

In this charming and chaotic little forest, you’ll find yourself in charge of a whole herd of quirky, bouncy animals just waiting for your skillful touch. Use your mouse to carefully launch each animal into the wooden pen, where things are never quite as calm as they seem. Every animal you fling tumbles, spins, and wiggles its way into place — but the real fun begins when two of the same kind find each other and magically combine into an even bigger, more delightful creature, right before your eyes. The more you merge, the more exciting and unpredictable the pen becomes, filling up with all sorts of hilarious animal antics.

There’s always a new high score to chase, always another adorable combination to discover, and always one more shot to take. How far can your clever moves and steady aim carry you in this whimsical forest challenge? Only the most determined players will unlock the true potential of their animal-flinging talents and leave their mark at the top of the leaderboard!

Take a break from the rush and dive into a delightful world filled with adorable critters and fun challenges. Whether you want to perfect your throw or just unwind with cute animals, Animal Smash is designed for easy, satisfying play.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 8/10/11
  • Processor: 2.33GHz or faster x86-compatible processor
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 10/11
  • Processor: Intel i3-4170 @ 3.7Ghz OR Intel i5 750 @ 2.67Ghz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
